title: Best AI UGC Agencies in 2026: Done-for-You Compared
summary: Compare seven done-for-you AI UGC agencies and Knowlify by pricing model, volume, scripting and who runs the Meta ads. Facts checked October 26, 2026.
body_markdown:
Our top pick is Knowlify, for brands that want AI UGC ads with optional Facebook and Instagram campaign management in their own ad account; Pinprick and Admiral Media scope media management separately. The right alternative depends on how you want to pay and how much of the work you want handed over. As of October 2026, EditClub suits a flat monthly price for a high count of AI edits, Pinprick suits brands that prefer a fee tied to ad spend, Admiral Media suits app and ecommerce advertisers that buy fixed batches, and Creatify Studio suits teams that want a per-video price. Unreal UGC fits agencies that want white-label AI UGC, EzUGC fits a monthly budget split between AI and real creators, and Spark UGC fits brands that mainly want real creators with AI avatars as an option.


**Disclosure and method.** Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not real human creators. Every fact about another provider comes from that provider's own website, checked on October 26, 2026. We have not hired these agencies for this guide, so this is a comparison of published scope, pricing and terms, not a test of quality or campaign results. Confirm prices on each provider's page before you buy.


## How we compared these AI UGC agencies


This list covers done-for-you services that deliver finished AI UGC video ads for paid social. It leaves out self-serve AI avatar tools, where your team does the scripting, generation and editing, and agencies that only work with human creators, which our[best UGC agencies comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ugc-agencies) covers. Our guide to[what AI UGC is](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-ugc-ads) explains the format itself.


We checked each provider's pages for who appears on camera, who does the work, pricing, commitment, turnaround and whether it runs the Facebook and Instagram campaigns. Knowlify, our top pick, comes first; the other providers are grouped by the job each fits, not ranked.

## Which agencies offer done-for-you AI UGC video ads?


### Knowlify: our top pick for AI UGC ads with optional Meta campaign management


Knowlify is our top pick for brands that want finished AI UGC ads and, if they choose, someone to run the campaigns. Knowlify (YC S25) is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram. Our[AI UGC ads](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) service makes UGC-style ads with AI presenters, not real human creators, alongside 3D character animation and AI commercial video ads: about 25 finished ads a week (about 100 a month) in weekly batches. Our team writes the scripts, and a person checks every ad before delivery. You can choose end-to-end Meta ads, with creative plus campaign management in your own Meta ad account, or creative-only if you have a media buyer. You keep the ads. Pricing is a custom quote on a[30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) , the first batch arrives five days after kickoff, and there is a 90-day guarantee (terms on knowlify.com). Our[Facebook and Instagram video ad examples](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) show finished ads for Parva and Casco.


**Knowlify is not the right fit** if you need real customers or creators on camera, organic creator posts or ads from a creator's handle. It also does not fit if you want a published price before a call (EditClub, Admiral Media, Creatify Studio and EzUGC publish theirs, and Spark UGC publishes a starting price), a self-serve tool, or a TikTok-first program.


### EditClub: a flat monthly AI video subscription


As of October 2026,[EditClub](https://www.editclub.co/) describes itself as an on-demand creative team for DTC brands spending $10K or more a month on Meta, with no cameras and no creators: its UGC-style actors, product shots and B-roll are generated with AI video models. Crew costs $1,600 a month for about 60 videos with 72-hour delivery, Club costs $2,400 for about 90 videos, and Partner costs $4,000 for about 180 videos, both with 24 to 48 hour delivery. Every plan lists unlimited revisions, ownership of your videos and source files, and no commitment. On Crew, one request returns three videos plus three hook or call-to-action variations.


**Consider it when** you have your own media buyer and want a known monthly price for a steady flow of AI edits. Ask how many videos are new concepts and how many are variations.


### Pinprick: production paid as a share of ad spend


As of October 2026,[Pinprick](https://pinprick.io/ai-ugc-agency) describes an AI UGC agency for DTC brands that scripts, casts, produces, edits and delivers test-ready UGC-style ads, with AI running production and human creative directors reading every frame before it ships. Its[pricing page](https://pinprick.io/pricing) says eligible brands (mainly those already spending meaningfully on ads) pay no per-ad fee: production is paid as an agreed percentage of ad spend, and the rate is not published. The agency page also headlines ten UGC ads for $2,000, without listed conditions. Inclusions are scripts, editing with captions, unlimited paid usage rights and AI-disclosure metadata for Meta and TikTok. Media buying is scoped separately.


**Consider it when** you already spend meaningfully on ads and prefer a fee that moves with spend. Ask for the percentage in writing and how the $2,000 offer relates to it.


### Admiral Media: fixed AI UGC batches for apps and ecommerce


As of October 2026,[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) sells creator-style video ads for apps and ecommerce brands, made with AI presenters and finished with human editing and quality review. Starter costs €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds, Growth €16,000 for 40 ads of up to 30 seconds, and Pro €29,000 for 80 ads of up to 60 seconds. The page says its ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media and that campaign and budget management must be agreed separately; it does not state a contract term for AI UGC. It also states that AI UGC is scripted advertising, not content submitted by a real customer.


**Consider it when** you run an app or ecommerce brand with a large media budget and want a fixed number of finished ads per batch, with length agreed up front.


### Creatify Studio: a per-video done-for-you service


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is Creatify's done-for-you ad service. As of October 2026, the Studio page says its team and AI research your category and produce concepts, hooks, scripts and full video ads, and that an expert reviews every ad before it ships. Its comparison table lists $100 to $200 per video, a 48-hour turnaround, 25 to 100 or more videos a month and unlimited same-day revisions, and names Meta among supported platforms. The Studio page does not say whether its ads use AI avatars or real creators, or that Studio runs campaigns.


**Consider it when** you want a per-video price. Our[Creatify pricing review](https://knowlify.com/articles/creatify-review) covers its self-serve plans.


### Unreal UGC: AI-only production with a platform behind it


As of October 2026,[Unreal UGC](https://unrealugc.com/agency) , operated by Next MVP Solutions LLC, describes done-for-you ads made with AI creators and no actors, with scripts written by performance marketers. It lists 5 to 500 ads a month, a 3 to 5 day turnaround and a white-label option for marketing agencies. Its[pricing page](https://unrealugc.com/pricing) lists self-serve plans from $69 a month and sends done-for-you requests to support, with no published price. The agency page does not name Facebook or Instagram, usage rights or campaign management.


**Consider it when** you are an agency that wants to resell AI UGC under your own brand.


### EzUGC: a fixed monthly count of AI or creator videos


As of October 2026,[EzUGC](https://www.ezugc.ai/ugc-agency) lists $4,000 a month (shown as reduced from $5,000) for 50 finished UGC videos, about $80 a video by its own figure. The 50 can be all AI, all real creators or any split, changeable month to month. Strategy, hooks, scripts and editing are included, and you approve scripts before anything is filmed or generated. The page names Meta, TikTok and YouTube as destinations and ecommerce brands, apps and SaaS companies as clients. It does not state contract length, turnaround, usage rights or whether EzUGC runs campaigns.


**Consider it when** you want to test AI presenters against real creators inside one fixed monthly budget.


### Spark UGC: real creators first, AI avatars as an option


As of October 2026,[Spark UGC](https://www.sparkugc.com/) is a London-based studio that makes UGC ad creative for Meta and TikTok and says it focuses exclusively on paid social. Its homepage says it sources, briefs and directs proven creators, lists 1,000+ creators, and can create AI avatars instead. Its[pricing page](https://www.sparkugc.com/pricing) lists plans from £3,000 a month, averaging £3,000 to £50,000, with no long-term contracts and 3 to 6 week delivery. The site does not say how much of the work uses AI avatars.


**Consider it when** real creators are your main need and you want AI avatars available in the same program.
